subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2**
solution:
The correct answer is 'anything'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given words - 
 
 
• **nothing - **not anything; no single thing.
 
• **everything - **all things.
 
• **anything - **used to refer to a thing, no matter what.
 
• **each thing** - every member of the group and considering them as individuals.
 
 
 
• We need a word for the given blank that would imply to all sorts of writing. 
 
• Hence, anything or option 3 is the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2. 

Correct passage__ - *Writing is a form (1) __of expression__, and neat handwriting is important when writing (2) __anything__ that will be read by someone else. We (3)__are often judged__ by the quality of our handwriting, and (4)__ when__ our handwriting is poor, we (5)__ appear__ to be lazy or incompetent.*
